Title: Fewer than 5% of the HTTP requests fail during and after the spike
Preconditions: The demo service https://quickpizza.grafana.com is reachable
Test Data: Default: 30 s warm-up, 10 s surge, 1 min hold, 10 s drop, 1 min recovery. Report run: 20 % of the users, 5/5/10/5/10 s (`-e SCALE=0.2 -e WARM=5s -e SURGE=5s -e HOLD=10s -e DROP=5s -e RECOVER=10s`, peak 10 VUs)
Steps: 1. Run `k6 run scripts/spike.js`. 2. Read the end-of-test summary.
Expected Result: Threshold `http_req_failed: rate<0.05` holds. Less than 5% of all HTTP requests failed.

Test Data: Default: 30 s warm-up, 10 s surge, 1 min hold, 10 s drop, 1 min recovery. Report run: 20 % of the users, 5/5/10/5/10 s (`-e SCALE=0.2 -e WARM=5s -e SURGE=5s -e HOLD=10s -e DROP=5s -e RECOVER=10s`, peak 10 VUs)
